landing.title: BIASHARA — Trusted mineral trading

priceTransparency.title: Transparent prices
priceTransparency.description: Real-time quotes and price history so you can negotiate with full clarity.

blockchainTraceability.title: Blockchain traceability
blockchainTraceability.description: Every lot is recorded and verifiable from the mine to the export port.

securePayments.title: Secure payments
securePayments.description: Protected transactions aligned with international standards.

smartLogistics.title: Smart logistics
smartLogistics.description: Shipment tracking and optimized logistics corridors.

aiMarketIntelligence.title: AI market intelligence
aiMarketIntelligence.description: Predictive analytics to anticipate trends in the mining market.

prices.title: Built for the future of mineral trade
prices.description: Every price on BIASHARA comes from real market data, refreshed continuously — no delays, no guesswork.

credibility.title: Built for the DRC mining ecosystem
credibility.subtitle: Informal transactions, opaque pricing, difficult market access for artisanal producers — BIASHARA addresses the real challenges of Congolese mineral trade.

kyc.title: KYC/AML compliance
kyc.description: Rigorous verification of every buyer and seller before any transaction.

traceability.title: Lot-level traceability
traceability.description: A unique identifier tracks every shipment from mine to buyer.

bilingual.title: Bilingual, built for the DRC
bilingual.description: Fully French platform with English for international buyers.
